remarks: One level living at its finest!  Welcome to 3 Briarwood Lane, set on a quiet & convenient lower North Stamford cul-de-sac, this updated ranch will not disappoint. The architect re-designed this charming home for his own family. Expanded and renovated with a large primary suite, two charming bedrooms-one with a fireplace, plus office/den. Interior features include: hardwood floors through-out, built-ins, and several access points to the charming outdoor patio. The updated chef's kitchen features top grade cabinetry and appliances, granite countertops and a large wet bar. Expanded from the kitchen is a family room with vaulted ceiling and three walls of glass allowing nature to be your decorator. Not to be overlooked is the level property, fenced in the back for your pets, plus garden and chicken coop!  This very well maintained home includes an automatic whole house generator plus Tesla charger.
